plan.title: Recreate Live RFQ Order with 45-Minute Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the Responses tab as required before accessing Settings.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order window opened.
Select the requested 45-minute custom evaluation duration option.
Create the recreated order with the selected duration.
Verify the order creation succeeded with the expected toast.
Verify the Recreate Order window closed after successful creation.
